name: blockvault
description: BlockVault - Blockchain-Based Document Verification & Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix blockchain install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix blockchain test
